test_easter_offset: test the Easter offset class computes correct Easter date for a given input date
test_western_easter_offset: test the Easter offset with EASTER_WESTERN method computes correct Western Easter dates
test_orthodox_easter_offset: test the Easter offset with EASTER_ORTHODOX method computes correct Orthodox Easter dates
create_easter_offset_forward: create an Easter offset and apply it forward to find the next Easter Sunday
create_easter_offset_negated: create a negated Easter offset to find the previous Easter Sunday from a given date
